description:
SURFACED by the fz-rh2.17.5.6.8.1 audit. After that ticket's strengthening (duplicate gate compares FULL StructDef fields+span, not span alone), the silent-OVERWRITE regression is closed: a macro-emitted defstruct dup with DIFFERENT fields now diagnoses. TWO residual items to settle before slice .13 deletes the old scan (the safety net):
1. REACHABILITY: can fz's macro system today actually emit a ScopeForm::Struct/defstruct from a macro body at all (expand_item_macro_fragment -> apply_scope_form -> publish_struct_def)? The .8.1 audit reasoned it PLAUSIBLE (a macro whose body contains a literal, non-unquoted defstruct template inherits the macro def-site span on every expansion) but could NOT reproduce it -- no fixture/test exercises macro-emitted defstruct. Write a fixture/test that either PROVES it reachable (two invocations of such a macro in one module) or proves it unreachable (fz macros can't emit defstruct). This determines whether the residual below matters at all.
2. RESIDUAL BENIGN MISS: if reachable, a macro dup with IDENTICAL fields (same span, same fields) is still treated as an idempotent re-run -> missed duplicate diagnostic. This is BENIGN (no data loss / no silent-wrong-fields, unlike the closed overwrite bug) but is a real missed-error edge. If (1) proves reachability, add coverage and decide whether to catch it (e.g. a per-body occurrence count during apply_ordered_forms, which is schedule-independent and doesn't rely on span OR content -- the architecturally-cleanest duplicate detector, distinct from the store-comparison heuristic).
Do BOTH before .13 permanently deletes module_struct_fields (the fallback). Related: fz-rh2.17.5.6.8.1, fz-rh2.17.5.6.9, fz-rh2.17.5.6.13.

comments.text: Folded at d905494aa. VERDICT: macro-emitted defstruct IS reachable (fz macros can emit a top-level defstruct via {:defstruct,%{},[fields]}; literal %{} meta -> Span::DUMMY on every expansion, confirming the identical-fields same-span hazard .8.1 left). RESOLVED (not deferred) with a per-ScopeSession struct_form_seen occurrence count: a second defstruct in one module-body pass (incl. macro-expanded, since apply_item_macro_call recurses on the same session without reassigning current_module) diagnoses RESOLVE_DUPLICATE_STRUCT regardless of content; .8.1's content-comparison is kept for cross-job-re-run idempotency (fresh session per run). ELIXIR-CONFIRMED: matches Kernel.Utils.defstruct (../elixir/lib/elixir/lib/kernel/utils.ex:110-114) 'defstruct can only be called once per module' -- content-independent, at the second call. Adversarial audit CLEAN (no MUST-FIX): ScopeSession lifetime correct (per-body reset, macro in-session, nested modules isolated -- all verified adversarially), no single-defstruct false-positive (the 19-regression class), per-session check runs before content-comparison (no double-diagnosis), keep-first holds, full Elixir-parity table a-e, test non-vacuous. lib 1273/0/6, matrix 352/11. .13 gate SOUND.

title: Confirm/cover macro-emitted defstruct duplication: same-span-identical-fields dup is a benign missed diagnostic; verify fz macros can even emit a defstruct
